menu.guest:
Hi 👋
Sign in to your account here, or create a new one.
menu.restricted:
Your account is restricted: for now you can only talk to support.
Reason: {{reason}}
menu.restrictedNoReason: Your account is restricted: for now you can only talk to support.

common.cancelled: Cancelled; nothing was saved. Start again below whenever you like.
common.unknown: I did not catch that. Here is what I can do:
common.pickOne: Please pick one of the options above.
common.tryAgain: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
common.staleUpdate: The bot was briefly unavailable, so that was not carried out. Please try again.
common.notSignedIn: You are not signed in yet.
common.expired: This conversation sat idle for a while, so I closed it; nothing was saved. Start again below.
common.backGone: There is nothing before this. You can start from here:
common.signedOutSwitched: Signed out of that account — you are now “{{name}}”.
common.signedOutAll: Signed out of every account in this chat. None of them was removed.
common.throttled: Too many sign-ins have been started from this chat just now, so you will need to wait a little. If you are in a hurry, open the app below and sign in there as usual.

login.askPhone: Send your number with the button below, or type it yourself. A number from any country works — write it with its country code, like +49…
login.askIdentifier: Send your username or phone number.
login.askPassword: Please send your password. Your message is deleted right away.
login.wrongCode: That code is not right. Send it again, or ask for a new one.
login.pickChannel: Where should I send the code?
login.askChatContact: Tap below to sign in with this account. No code, no password — sending your number is the proof.

channel.none: There is no way to send the code right now. Please try again in a moment.
channel.sent: The code is on its way.

link.required: Open {{platform}} with the button below and send your number there. Then come back and send me the code.
link.waiting: I cannot see it yet. Finish up in {{platform}}, then tap this button again.

register.askPassword: Pick a password and send it. Your message is deleted right away.
register.passwordKept: I could not delete your message — please delete it yourself.
register.done: Your account is ready and you are signed in ✅

forgot.askPassword: Send your new password. Your message is deleted right away.
forgot.done: Your password is changed and your other devices are signed out ✅

help.body:
I look after your account right here in the chat: sign in, create an account, or change your password — without going anywhere else.

/menu — the main menu
/logout — sign out of this chat

command.cancel: Drop what we are in the middle of

language.only: This bot speaks one language for now.

timeZone.followsPanel: 🕒 I follow the panel now. Your clock: {{zone}}.

accounts.pick: You are signed in as {{name}}. Tap any other account to carry on as that one.
accounts.none:
You are signed in as {{name}}, and no other account is linked to it.
Add one below and you can move between them here with a single tap.
accounts.addPickProof: How should we add that account?
accounts.addAskPhone: Send that account's number, with its country code if it is not from here. The code goes to that number, not to this chat.
accounts.addAskIdentifier: Send that account's username or phone number.
accounts.addAskPassword: Send that account's password. Your message is deleted right away.
accounts.added: The account is added, but you are still signed in as before. Open “My accounts” to switch to it.
accounts.removePick: Which account should leave this chat? It is removed here only.
accounts.removeConfirm:
Remove {{name}} from this chat's accounts?
You can add it back whenever you like.
accounts.removeConfirmSelf:
Remove {{name}} — the one you are using right now?
You will be signed out of this chat, and the others stay where they are.
accounts.removedSelf: Removed, and you are signed out here. Sign in again whenever you like.
accounts.removeFailed: That account is no longer one of this chat's accounts.
accounts.signOutAllAsk: You will be signed out of every account in this chat. None is removed, and they stay reachable later without a new code. Sure?

topUp.pickGateway: Which gateway would you like to pay with?
topUp.none: No payment gateway is available right now. Please try again a little later.
topUp.askAmount: How much would you like to add, in {{currency}}? Pick an amount or type one.
topUp.pay: Your payment is ready. Tap the button below to pay — once it is confirmed, you will get a message here.
topUp.credited: {{credited}} was added to your wallet. Your balance is now {{balance}} ✅
topUp.payInChat: Your invoice is below. Pay it right here in the chat — you will get a message as soon as it is confirmed.
topUp.paidPending: Your payment arrived and is being checked. You will get a message here once it is in your wallet.
topUp.refusedNotFound: This invoice is not yours or no longer exists. Start a new top-up from the menu.
topUp.refusedNotPayable: This invoice has expired or was already paid. Start a new top-up from the menu.
topUp.refusedAmount: This invoice no longer matches its payment. Start a new top-up from the menu.

reseller.home: Look after your reseller right here.
reseller.usersPick: {{shown}} of {{total}} customers. Pick one, or type a name, username or number to search.
reseller.usersEmpty: Nobody has signed up on your reseller yet.
reseller.usersNoMatch: No customer matches “{{q}}”. Try something else, or see all of them.
reseller.searchTooShort: Type at least three characters to search.
reseller.blockAsk: Restrict {{name}}? They are signed out once; after that they can only talk to support.

campaign.ask: About {{count}} people will get it. Now write the message.
campaign.empty: Nobody is in that group right now. Pick another one.
campaign.statusDraft: This message has not gone out yet.
campaign.statusSending: Sending… {{sent}} have it so far, {{failed}} did not go through.
campaign.statusCompleted: Sending finished ✅ {{sent}} got it, {{failed}} did not go through.
campaign.statusStopped: Sending was stopped. {{sent}} had it, {{failed}} did not go through.
campaign.list: Your recent broadcasts. Pick one to see where it is.
campaign.listEmpty: You have not sent a bulk message yet.
campaign.readOnly: You cannot start a new broadcast right now, but here is what you have sent.

suggestion.optedOut: 🔕 Done. You won't get suggestions like this again.
suggestion.gone: This suggestion is no longer available.

wheel.none: There is no wheel running today. Check back later.
wheel.failed: The wheel could not be reached. Tap Spin again — the same spin will not be counted twice.

won.bonus_traffic_gb: 🎉 You won {{value}} GB — added to your service {{service}}.
won.extra_days: 🎉 You won {{value}} extra days — added to your service {{service}}.
won.discount_coupon:
🎉 You won a {{value}}% discount coupon.
Your code: {{code}}
won.empty: No prize this time. Better luck next spin!

refusals.account_too_new: Your account is too new. Try again in a little while.
refusals.no_active_service: You need an active service to spin.
refusals.paid_too_little: The wheel is for customers who have bought a little more.
refusals.too_few_orders: The wheel is for customers with a few more paid orders.
refusals.not_in_group: This wheel is for a group of users you are not in.
refusals.flagged: Your account is under review, so it cannot spin.
refusals.shared_device: Too many accounts have used this chat, so it cannot spin.
refusals.daily_limit: You have used today's spins. Come back tomorrow.
refusals.cooldown: Wait a little before your next spin.
refusals.no_wheel: There is no wheel running today.
refusals.no_fingerprint: This chat could not be recognised. Open the menu and try again.
refusals.spin_in_progress: Your spin is already being processed. Tap Spin again in a moment.

wheel.unreachable: 🚫 = this prize cannot reach your services (GB only to a service with a volume, days only to one with an end date)

lotteries.list: 🎟 Your lotteries ({{n}}). Choose one to see its prizes and your entry.
lotteries.none: There is no lottery for you right now.

entry.automatic: Every eligible member of the group is entered at the close — nothing to do.
entry.canJoin: Entry is free. Tap Join to take part.
entry.joined: You are in. Your ticket number is given when the lottery closes.

excluded.not_in_group: You were no longer in the lottery's group at the close.
excluded.inactive: Your account was not active at the close.
excluded.account_too_new: Your account was too new at the close.
excluded.phone_unverified: Your phone number was not verified at the close.
excluded.flagged: Your account was under review at the close.
excluded.shared_device: Too many accounts have used your device.

refusals.lottery_not_found: This lottery is not available to you.
refusals.not_opt_in: This lottery enters its members automatically; there is nothing to join.
refusals.not_drawn: This lottery has not been drawn yet.

lotteries.noPlaces: There were no tickets, so nobody was drawn.

mine.lost: Your ticket #{{n}} did not win this time.

prizeService.automatic: Automatic — the service that runs longest
prizeService.saved: ✅ Saved. GB and days you win now go to: {{current}}
prizeService.none: Nothing to choose: GB and days you win go to your active service on their own.

refusals.grant_not_found: This service was not found. Tap «Prize service» again.
refusals.grant_not_eligible: Prizes can no longer go to this service. Choose another one.

support.list: 💬 Your support conversations. Choose one, or start a new one.
support.none: You have no support conversation yet. Start one and we will answer you right here.
support.earlier: … earlier messages are in the app.

prompt.reply: Type your reply, or send a photo or a PDF.
prompt.resolved: Marked resolved. If it is not, just reply and it opens again — or rate the answer.

support.compose: Write your message. Once it is open you can send photos or PDFs too.
support.composeFileFirst: Write your message first — you can send the file right after.
support.fileOutside: To send a file to support, open a conversation first.
support.fileUnreadable: That file could not be read. Send it again, or as a photo or a PDF.

refusals.closed: This conversation is closed. Reopen it, or start a new one.
refusals.category_unknown: That topic is no longer available. Start again.
refusals.too_many_unfinished: You already have several open conversations. Finish one of them first.
refusals.too_many_files: Too many files in one message.
refusals.file_rejected: Only photos (PNG, JPEG, WebP) and PDFs can be sent.
refusals.file_infected: That file did not pass the virus check and was not sent.
refusals.scan_unavailable: Files cannot be checked right now. Try again in a few minutes.
refusals.quota_exceeded: Your space for support files is full.
refusals.not_finished: You can rate it once it is resolved.
refusals.already_rated: You have already rated this conversation.
refusals.reopen_expired: It is too late to reopen this one. Start a new conversation.

support.suggested: These guides may already answer it. Open one — or send your message anyway, and support will answer here.

guides.menu: 📖 Guides. Choose one, or see how to connect on your device.
guides.pickOs: Which device do you want to connect?
guides.noneForOs: There is no guide for this system yet.
guides.failed: Guides cannot be opened right now. Please try again in a moment.
guides.gone: This guide is no longer available.

feedback.failed: Your answer was not saved. Please try again in a moment.

ask.receiptImage: send a photo of the receipt here 📎
ask.sourceCardLast4: type the last 4 digits of the card you paid from.
ask.paidAt: when did you pay? Pick the nearest.

transfer.photoExpected: Please send the receipt as a photo.
transfer.textExpected: Please type it as a message.
transfer.fileUnreadable: That file could not be read here. Please send the receipt as a photo again.
transfer.sent: ✅ Your receipt was sent. It will be checked, and you will get a message here as soon as the amount is in your wallet.
transfer.alreadySent: Your receipt is already waiting to be checked. You will get a message here once it is confirmed.
transfer.closed: This payment is closed and takes no receipt now. Start a new top-up from the menu.

refused.transfer_not_found: This payment was not found. Start a new top-up from the menu.
refused.transfer_closed: This payment is closed and takes no receipt now. Start a new top-up from the menu.
refused.proof_already_sent: Your receipt is already waiting to be checked.
refused.invalid_proof: The {{field}} you sent does not look right. Please {{ask}}
refused.receipt_missing: The receipt photo did not arrive. Please {{ask}}
refused.receipt_rejected: That file cannot be used as a receipt: send a photo (JPEG, PNG or WebP) of at most 5 MB.
refused.duplicate_ref: This tracking code or transaction hash was already used for another payment. Check it, then send your proof again with the “📎 Send the receipt” button above.

review.list: 🧾 Receipts waiting for your review. Choose one:
review.none: No receipt is waiting for review ✅
review.noPicture: The receipt picture could not be shown here; it is on the manual payments page of the panel.
review.gone: This payment no longer waits for review: it was confirmed, rejected or closed.
review.rejectAsk: Reject this payment for good? Its user is not credited, and if the money did arrive, only support can put it right.
review.confirmed: ✅ Confirmed. The amount was added to the user's wallet.
review.returned: ↩️ Sent back. The user can send a new receipt, once.
review.settled: This payment was already settled; nothing was changed.
review.duplicate: This tracking code was already credited to another payment, so this one was not confirmed.
review.cannotReturn: This receipt was already sent back once. Confirm or reject it.
review.reasonConfirm: Confirmed in the bot after checking the receipt
review.reasonReturn: Sent back from the bot for a new receipt
review.reasonReject: Rejected in the bot after checking the receipt

services.list: 🛡 Your services ({{n}}). Pick one to see where it stands.{{more}}
services.more: You have {{n}} more — the app shows them all.
services.gone: This service is no longer in your list.

status.suspended: Stopped — out of traffic or credit

frozenBy.self: 🧊 You froze this service; unfreeze it whenever you like.{{until}}
frozenBy.soft: 🧊 Support froze this service, and you may unfreeze it yourself.{{until}}
frozenBy.hard: 🧊 Support froze this service, and only support can lift it.{{until}}

services.frozenUntil: The freeze lifts by itself in {{left}}.
services.freezeAsk: Freeze «{{name}}»? No device connects with it until you unfreeze it.
services.freezeLimited: A service can be frozen at most {{limit}} times in 24 hours. You can freeze this one again in {{left}}.

renewal.plans:
🔄 Renew «{{name}}»
Pick a plan; the service's own plan is first.{{notSold}}
renewal.notSold: This service's own plan is no longer sold; pick one of the others.
renewal.none: This service has no plan to renew to right now.
renewal.askGib: How many GB should be added to «{{name}}»? Send a number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
renewal.askDays: How many days should be added to «{{name}}»? Send a number from {{min}} to {{max}}.
renewal.stale: This screen is old; tap «🔄 Renew» again.
renewal.paid:
✅ The service is renewed.
Paid: {{total}} — wallet balance: {{balance}}
renewal.shortfall:
Your wallet is short for this renewal: {{missing}} more is needed.
Top up your wallet, then tap «🔁 Pay again».
